SCAM ALERT ‼️

Stay the hell away from BIDC EMQUARTIER Dental Clinic unless you enjoy throwing your money in the bin and being blatantly scammed. Do NOT fall for their shiny fake reviews – it’s all lies and fraud.

I was sold a “dental cleansing and flushing” that they told me would last at least an hour. I show up today, the so-called hygienist tells me it’s just some cleaning and a “water flush” and even asked if I knew what that was. What?? Isn’t the whole point that it’s meant to be a hygienic treatment? Then she casually drops the price – 2000 baht ($62) for a cleaning and another 1600 baht ($50) for this nonsense “water flush.”

Guess how long the whole thing lasted? TEN pathetic minutes. Ten minutes for what was supposed to be a one-hour treatment. And to slap me in the face even harder, the receptionist had the nerve to add on another 160 baht for “cleaning.” Absolute daylight robbery.

This place is not a clinic – it’s a scam factory. Avoid it at all costs.

I came here after reading the good reviews and requested a check-up and cleaning - but the experience was not up to my expectations. The dentist scraped my teeth so quickly and carelessly that it was unlike anything I had ever experienced with other dentists. She claimed it was due to my gum recession, but I can tell the discomfort was also from the speed at which she moved the sharp instrument(and very minimum care when I reacted to the pain). I also didn’t feel that my plaque was properly cleaned. Additionally, she didn’t notice that a filling had come off until I pointed it out. I have a couple of cavities but she didn’t even care to check its depth. A more thorough and careful examination would make the visit worth the money.

Also, on the day of the appointment, they asked me to come in earlier since they are available. I said I can’t, and the operator didn’t sound happy. I have my own plans, and they should respect that.
Very nice staffs and everything is soo good. We will be back

I’ve been a longtime patient of Bangkok International Dental Center (BIDC), but since I was staying nearby, I decided to try the BIDC Dental Clinic @ Emquartier for convenience. Big mistake.

From the start, it felt less like a branch and more like a franchise. They didn’t even have access to my records from the main center — a red flag.

I was there for a checkup and cleaning. The dentist barely glanced at my teeth before saying “no cavities” and jumping straight to the cleaning. No greeting, no small talk — just sit down, open your mouth, and endure. The assistant kept shoving my head around, and I was only allowed to close my mouth once during the entire procedure. The clinic was empty, so I can’t explain the rush.

At the end, I got a quick “you need to floss” while she turned the chair away from me — I guess that was my cue to leave. No business card, or I’d post it here to warn others.
